title: Solar Maverick Podcast #289 (Benoy Thanjan) — 'Mission alone is not enough'
summary: Benoy Thanjan — Founder & CEO of Reneu Energy and host of the Solar Maverick Podcast (Top Global Solar Podcast) — releases his Incorruptible episode with Eric, using the Sol Price / FedMart / Costco arc as the throughline for the renewable energy industry: how mission-driven clean energy companies can protect their purpose from capital pressure through governance and legal structure.
blockquote: Eric's message is that mission alone is not enough. Companies need governance, aligned investors, and legal structures that protect their purpose when pressure inevitably arrives.
attribution_title: Founder & CEO, Reneu Energy; Host, Solar Maverick Podcast
